retrospective.problem: A briefing that adds a repair plan can steer the coder away from grounded task history; earlier small-decision experiments confused historical code with operative advice.
critical_errors: Treating a new repair prescription as mere history
Treating quoted past actions or unmet original outcomes as a fresh plan
measure: Per-class confusion and PLAN recall on real held-out tasks
Hard-contrast performance separately from all real diagnostic traffic

dictation.problem: A guidance message must not smuggle unverified literal code or commands to copy; error quotes and existing identifiers must remain usable.
critical_errors: Approving new literal code as descriptive guidance
Blocking an existing-code/error quote merely because it resembles code
measure: DICTATES miss rate and DESCRIBES false-positive rate
Quoted reality versus literal prescription challenge coverage

not_solved_by_these_targets.completion_truth: High-severity separate problem. No completion authority is trained here. Complete evidence in the prior satisfaction diagnostic exceeded short encoder windows; do not clip it or train a candidate-only surrogate.
not_solved_by_these_targets.stalled_work_and_rumination: No new public-progress classifier: earlier seed sketches were withdrawn for inadequate evidence. A targeted complete-state packet and independently adjudicated outcomes remain required.
not_solved_by_these_targets.search_direction: Direction reversals and normalized-equality bypass are documented opportunities, not established as repaired by either active head. Current search-rehunt remains separate; removed outgoing relevance stays removed.
not_solved_by_these_targets.upstream_missing_inputs: The 132 unrecoverable candidate packets stay ineligible. A classifier must not compensate for missing evidence or receive these as negative/UNKNOWN training targets.
not_solved_by_these_targets.execution_freshness_ownership: Remain deterministic, never learned from semantic labels.

sampling: Complete remaining known-lineage corpus, not favorable snippets or easy code areas; all raw inputs preserved and complete before labels. Six task families remain grouped across heads, sessions, retries/refolds and exact duplicates.
challenge_role: 20 exposed curated cases from the SAME real task-heldout diagnostic pool; not 20 additional independent examples, not a fresh benchmark, never calibration/training/augmentation sources.

challenge_pairs.problem_contrast: Literal new lookup versus required argument type
Invalid versus valid-looking replacement syntax still dictates
Existing-call diagnosis versus literal new probe
Quoted existing package versus prescribed CLI call
New wrapping remedy versus failed historical edits
Operative signature-and-test advice versus missing-state report
Unmet E2E outcome versus specific next test action
Broken-test history versus new lockfile-removal instruction
Historical tool/code detail versus next Docker repair commands

unresolved_policy_boundaries: Past unexecuted intent, prescription by reference, summary-author instructions and privacy/provenance uncertainty remain quarantined rather than forced into agreement.
prior_experiments: Earlier diagnostic banks and replay controls remain explicitly exposed; do not promote them to untouched evaluation.
release_limit: No evidence of improved usefulness, completion safety or deployed accuracy. No training/GPU clearance.
